# Measured savings and quality

- Run: 2026-10-17T00:05:19-0400 to 2026-10-17T00:12:05-0400; corpus cutoff 2026-10-17; repo dbf5a2c
- Claude Code 2.1.302 (Claude Code); job models claude-sonnet-5-5; judge claude-opus-5-5
- Local model qwen3.6-35b-a3b-splash (pinned in the plugin snapshots; all 1 footers matched); server @houtini/lm@3.3.4; LM Studio CLI commit dcefd5a
- Every session: `claude -p --output-format stream-json --setting-sources project --no-session-persistence`, default model, a constant empty cwd outside `$HOME`, claude.ai connectors off (`ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false`). Plugin on adds `--plugin-dir` (a snapshot of the repo; the ~2k, ~5k and ~10k files use a copy whose skill floor reads 1k instead of 10k).

**Metrics.** The gate is Claude cost: a job's cost is its run's `total_cost_usd` minus the median control of its configuration (`Reply with the single word OK.`, 3 per configuration, after one discarded warm-up), and savings = 1 − Σ job cost on / Σ job cost off over the main files, at least 50%. Beside it, not gated: T = input + cache_creation + cache_read + output (summed over the result event's `modelUsage`, minus the control's the same way) and context growth (the largest single-call input side, input + cache_read + cache_creation, minus the control's: the file tokens that entered the main context). A plugin-on job's delegation failure (no-call, call-error) stays in at its actual cost and is not usable. Any other run that is not positively measured (all four usage counters and the cost, a clean trace, the plugin tool present exactly when on, an ok status) leaves its metric incomplete, and an incomplete metric cannot pass. Fixed cost = cost(control on) − cost(control off), tokens beside; break-even = ceil(fixed cost / mean(job cost off − job cost on)). Small files take the median rep by cost. SLOW: a local call over 60 s, a timeout, or a plugin-on session over 60 s with no footer; "unknown" when a time is missing.
